html: The Wagiman, also spelt Wagoman, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Northern Territory, in the country of the upper Daly River and around Pine Creek. The map shows them from 1600 to 1815. Their neighbours were the Kungarakany and Malak-Malak to the north, the Ngan'giwumirri to the west, the Jaminjung to the southwest and the Nungali to the south. The Pine Creek gold rush of the 1870s and the railway from Darwin brought miners onto their land. Their language now has very few speakers.
